identity: Starbough's boughs are being emptied by snares: poachers trap what the vale raises and sell it to the bandits at the old camp.

quests.title: For the Snared
quests.text: A torn patch of fur tells me more about the poachers than all their talk of tending the wood. Bring me five Sunleaf for the animals hurt by their snares. Some will let me near them; the others have good reason to be wary of hands.
quests.lesson: The zone's first errand, a level only; the early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: A Cruel Use for a Knot
quests.text: Someone has taken the knot we use to steady young trees and made a snare of it. Cut the snare bundle at the {name:snare_ground}, {dir_from_giver:snare_ground}, in the {name:lower_boughs}, then return to me. The creatures there should be able to put a paw down without a noose waiting for it.
quests.completion: That snare will catch nothing more. Thank you for taking the trouble to undo what someone else found profitable.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Follow the Hands
quests.text: The snares tell me where the animals suffer, but little about who pays to have them set. Speak to Theren Farstep at Starbough Outpost and carry him my concern. He follows the traders; I would rather he knew what their business leaves behind.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Light Between the Trees
quests.text: The poachers know these paths well enough to move a load after dusk. Bring me twenty Torches for our watch along their trails. A little light at the right crossing saves a great deal of searching through undergrowth.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Where a Path Belongs
quests.text: Our path markings have faded, and strangers have started cutting their own marks into the bark to find their way. Bring me six Wooden Signs for the paths. I should like to give them directions before someone brings an axe into the conversation.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Teeth Along the Path
quests.text: The path wardens are being harried by Thicket Vixens when they go out to work. Hunt seven by day in the {name:greenwood}, which lies {zone_area:greenwood}. Watching for snares is difficult enough without watching for teeth at the same time.
quests.lesson: A day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Nima Knows the Hands
quests.text: Nima Fern is being held in the {name:bandit_camp}, {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}. Go and listen to her; she has watched the hands that set these snares and knows whose work they are. A trader can change a story more easily than a practised knot.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Ten Ways Back Up
quests.text: The old ladders have begun shedding rungs, and the walkway crews cannot grow wings to suit them. Bring me ten Wooden Ladders for the climbs between the boughs. I like to see everyone who goes up come down at a pace of their own choosing.
quests.lesson: A craft from Basic recipes; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: {name:snarekeeper_vetch}'s Handiwork
quests.text: I have watched Poacher Snarekeeper Vetch tie the same knots our tenders use, then tighten them into traps for the animals he sells. Kill him {dir_from_giver:snarekeeper_vetch} in the {name:high_boughs}, and bring me word. He knows exactly what those hands could have mended.
quests.completion: Vetch is down, and there will be no more snares from his hands. The knots he misused can still hold a young tree upright; I would like to see more of them doing that.
quests.lesson: The named perpetrator at his place; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: The Limits of a Seal
quests.text: I have seen the bough-seal held up as permission to take whatever the poachers can carry. Tell Eriath Boughwarden in Lethariel what I witnessed, and give him my name: Nima Fern. A mark meant to protect careful tending should not leave the tenders explaining why their wood is gone.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: the departure id stays; free from 19, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §1, §2).
